input.goal: Build a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo with a hand-written software 3D renderer (no WebGL, no libraries) drawing to a full-viewport 2D canvas, with an orbiting camera and a glassmorphism HUD.
constraints: Files: index.html loads engine3d.js (math, projection, painter's-algorithm triangle/quad fill with flat shading), scene.js (geometry builders), app.js (loop, HUD, window.app) via plain <script> tags; no external URLs, no modules, works from file://.
Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> filling window, resized on window resize, devicePixelRatio aware; body margin 0, overflow hidden.
Background: dark radial gradient space, center #1a0b3d to edge #05010f, painted each frame on the canvas.

Scene: two-tier platform (lower wide box, upper smaller box), twin pillars, a lintel across the pillar tops and a crown cap on the lintel: exactly 6 boxes x 6 faces = 36 box faces. Box colors dark #1b1440 with neon edges strokes in #00f0ff and #ff2bd6.

Six octahedral crystals (8 triangles each = 48 triangles) orbiting the portal at mid height, each spinning, colors alternating #00f0ff, #ff2bd6, #9d4dff, drawn with additive glow (globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' or shadowBlur).

Portal core between the pillars: glowing radial-gradient disk plus two concentric neon rings (projected 3D polylines, ≥48 segments each) rotating in opposite directions; inner ring #ff2bd6, outer ring #00f0ff.
Cyber grid floor: neon magenta/cyan grid lines on the ground plane y=0, fading with distance, scrolling slowly.
180 stars as small dots with twinkling alpha (per-star sine phase); 110 particles rising upward from the platform, respawning at the bottom when above a max height, colored cyan/magenta.
Camera orbits the portal around the Y axis, looking at the portal center, slightly elevated; orbit angle advances by dt*speed when orbit is on and not paused.

HUD: fixed top-left glassmorphism panel (background rgba(20,10,50,0.35), backdrop-filter blur(12px), 1px border rgba(0,240,255,0.4), border-radius 14px, light text #e8f6ff, monospace font). Title element #title text exactly 'NEON PORTAL 3D' with cyan text-shadow glow.
HUD stats: element #fps shows 'FPS: <n>', #polys shows 'POLYS: <n>' (number of polygons drawn last frame), #parts shows 'PARTS: <n>' (110).

HUD buttons: #pause toggles pause (text 'Pause' when running, 'Resume' when paused); #orbit toggles orbit (text 'Orbit ON' / 'Orbit OFF'); #reset resets camera angle to 0, speed to 1, unpauses, orbit ON, and slider value to 1.
Speed slider: <input type=range id="speed" min=0 max=3 step=0.1 value=1> labeled 'Speed'; input event sets app.speed to its numeric value.

window.app object with fields: paused (bool), orbit (bool), speed (number), camAngle (number, radians), boxFaces (36), crystalTris (48), stars (array length 180), particles (array length 110, each with y), polys (number drawn last frame), frames (incrementing frame counter, also while paused).
When paused, scene time, camAngle and particles do not advance, but rendering continues.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#c"},{"text":"#title","match":"^NEON PORTAL 3D$"},{"exists":"#fps"},{"exists":"#polys"},{"text":"#parts","match":"PARTS: 110"},{"exists":"input#speed[type=range]"},{"js":"app.boxFaces===36 && app.crystalTris===48 && app.stars.length===180 && app.particles.length===110"},{"js":"document.getElementById('c').width>=window.innerWidth*0.9"},{"wait":800},{"js":"app.frames>5 && app.polys>=84"},{"expect":"moving"},{"js":"window._a=app.camAngle; true"},{"click":"#pause"},{"js":"app.paused===true && /Resume/.test(document.getElementById('pause').textContent)"},{"js":"window._b=app.camAngle; window._y=app.particles[0].y; true"},{"wait":400},{"js":"app.camAngle===window._b && app.particles[0].y===window._y"},{"click":"#orbit"},{"js":"app.orbit===false && /Orbit OFF/.test(document.getElementById('orbit').textContent)"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"js":"app.speed===2.5"},{"click":"#reset"},{"js":"app.paused===false && app.orbit===true && app.speed===1 && app.camAngle<0.2 && document.getElementById('speed').value==='1'"}]}

content.text:
I've built the neon portal demo with Tandem, and it passed all of the automated browser checks. It's in four files: `index.html`, `engine3d.js` (the hand-written renderer, no WebGL), `scene.js` and `app.js`. Open `index.html` in a browser to run it.

The checks confirmed:
- **Scene contents:** 36 box faces, 48 crystal triangles, 180 stars and 110 particles.
- **HUD:** the title reads NEON PORTAL 3D and the PARTS counter shows 110.
- **Controls:** Pause, Orbit ON/OFF, the speed slider and Reset all work, and pausing freezes the camera and particles.

I didn't look at the result or read the code myself. The look (colours, glow, gradients) was set in the instructions to the local model, but no check covers it, so open the page to make sure it looks how you want.
